The plate looks like a square-ish side plate of about 20-22 cm. It holds six cucumber slices, which are half-moons about 5-6 cm across and roughly 0.7-1 cm thick. A half-moon with a 6 cm diameter has an area of about 14 cm². Multiplied by a thickness of about 0.8 cm, that is roughly 11 cm³, or about 10 g per slice. Several slices are smaller, so I estimate about 8 g on average, which gives a total near 50 g.
